## Summary and scope

Describe the change, exact files affected, and what is intentionally outside scope.

## Verification evidence

Provide exact commit SHA(s), test commands/results, relevant GitHub Actions run links, and any documented limitations or skipped checks.

## Review and safety checklist

- [ ] I inspected the complete diff and confirmed that only intended files changed.
- [ ] I checked for secrets, credentials, sensitive local paths, and private data. No real secrets or personal data are included.
- [ ] I kept unrelated runtime, schema, dependency, CI, and cognition changes out of this PR.
- [ ] I identified an independent reviewer where the project gate requires one, and did not represent author self-review as independent approval.
- [ ] I verified the exact PR-head CI evidence required for this change.
- [ ] I identified any outstanding checks, risks, and decisions requiring owner approval.
- [ ] If relevant to B10, G7/I31 authorization and empirical-dispatch locks remain unchanged unless the owner separately authorized those changes.

## Merge and post-merge

State the merge strategy, required post-merge `master` CI checks, and the documentation/closure status that will remain pending until those checks pass.

**Do not claim a review, test, deployment, scientific outcome, or authorization that has not actually occurred.**
